column1: # Carried items that hold their charges as component items (OSRS Wiki, checked 2026-10-25). While carried, the
# charge varbit counts as those items, so charging and uncharging net to zero and each spent charge is a cost.
# Every id is written number=GAMEVAL_NAME; StoredChargesTest checks each one against RuneLite's constants.
# Recipe arithmetic is source-backed; new-item native counter freshness remains unverified.
# item, charge varbit, charges per set, then quantity / item pairs for one set.
# Stores whose contents live in varbits (OSRS Wiki, checked 2026-11-01): the plank sack (planks are used
# straight from it; Session Tracker, TicTac7x), the master scroll book (coinflow; the Watson scroll is split
# across two varbits and left out), the bowstring spool (fills itself while spinning flax; TicTac7x) and the
# ring of the elements (one air, earth, fire, water and law rune per teleport; TicTac7x).
# Charged items whose counter is a CHARGES_*_QUANTITY varbit (OSRS Wiki charging sections, checked 2026-11-02):
# alchemist's amulet (10 charges per amulet of chemistry), ring of shadows, soul bearer, giantsoul amulet (never
# refunds), circlet of water, horn of plenty, Xeric's talisman, celestial ring and signet (one counter, stardust).
# StoredChargesTest.everyChargesVarbitIsMappedOrExcluded lists the counters left out and why.
